purpose: Propose independent candidate retrieval paths for actual AR06/AS05 entrypoint
hypothesis: Tone-independent n-gram and phonetic retrieval may recover names missed by prefix-oriented and tonnage-window retrieval
changed_factors: Phase A: fixed-catalog n-gram retrieval only; candidate limit is an initial setting, not optimized
Later independent comparisons: mixed Hangul variants, phonetic n-gram, quality-based expansion, shortlist protection
fixed_conditions: Freeze baseline scorer, metadata rule, LM checkpoint and fusion settings in first comparison
Use official vessel-group folds; no fitting on heldout/test queries
Preserve baseline candidate set and duplicate-name vessel IDs before pruning

retrieval.candidate_budget_unit: Name/index hits before expanding all same-name IDs; final ID count measured separately
retrieval.first_rollout: Non-Hangul and Hangul as separate comparisons

observations: AS05 actual ZIP uses exact, prefix/suffix, first-character phonetic/skeleton and tonnage channels; no CharacterNgramIndex integration.
Candidate count <200 and empty-set checks drive expansion; these do not measure retrieval quality.
Hangul full variants combine same-rank word alternatives, limiting mixed-rank combinations.
Number posting lists longer than 500 are skipped; use joint name/number retrieval as a later proposal.
Existing model/ngram_retrieval.py implements sparse fixed-catalog 2-4gram retrieval; adapt imports/normalization and use vessel ID tie-break explicitly.
limitations: No retrieval enhancement implemented or timed.
Old retrieval-combination experiments used other models/splits and do not establish AS05 improvement.
Full Fold0 cached top35 already covers every gold target; stress/rare-type controls are required to test recovery.
decision: Start with a separate global n-gram candidate union; evaluate inclusion before and after top35 pruning and final Fix/Break before expanding other channels.
next_actions: Compare original retrieval vs added global n-grams with original scorer and same candidates policy on a small heldout cohort plus clearly labeled stress transformations.
Measure candidate origin, unique recoveries, union size, recall at fixed shortlist K, Fix/Break and timing.
